description: Known defects in BMA that standard bash audit cannot detect but semantic deep-audit SHOULD detect. Used to validate deep-audit.py acceptance criterion: >=3 findings that bash misses.

known_defects.description: Schema 'ds-finding.schema.json' has no validation consumer in executable code
known_defects.why_bash_misses: Requires cross-referencing schema filename across all script files, not just checking file existence
known_defects.verification: grep -rn 'ds-finding.schema.json' scripts/ Makefile --include='*.sh' --include='*.py' | wc -l should be 0

known_defects.description: Schema 'principle-ledger.schema.json' has no validation consumer in executable code
known_defects.why_bash_misses: Same as KD-1: cross-file reference analysis beyond pattern matching
known_defects.verification: grep -rn 'principle-ledger.schema.json' scripts/ Makefile --include='*.sh' --include='*.py' | wc -l should be 0

known_defects.description: Constitution claims T1 via 'make sync-counters' but Makefile target does not exist
known_defects.why_bash_misses: Requires parsing prose in constitution, extracting make target names, then checking Makefile for those targets

known_defects.description: Skills 'fleet-dispatch' and 'scorecard-comparison' exist on disk but missing from AGENTS.md Skills table
known_defects.why_bash_misses: Requires comparing directory listing to parsed markdown table rows
known_defects.verification: ls -d .agents/skills/fleet-dispatch/ .agents/skills/scorecard-comparison/ should succeed; grep 'fleet-dispatch\|scorecard-comparison' in Skills table should find 0

known_defects.description: Scripts 'backfill-principle-ledger.py' and 'test-l1-apply-hygiene.sh' are never referenced from any caller
known_defects.why_bash_misses: Requires full-repo cross-reference search to prove ABSENCE of references, not just presence of the file
known_defects.verification: grep -rn 'backfill-principle-ledger\|test-l1-apply-hygiene' Makefile AGENTS.md scripts/ .github/ .agents/ tests/ should find 0 external refs

known_defects.description: AGENTS.md has inconsistent learnings counts (342 vs L1-L329 vs actual 344+)
known_defects.why_bash_misses: Requires extracting numbers from prose in multiple locations, comparing them, and counting actual entries
